summary: Config-fix verification for Google OAuth (Supabase provider enable). Verified 3 things: (1) curl GET {SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1/settings with anon apikey now returns external.google=true (previously false). (2) On /login, clicking [data-testid=login-google-button] issues a 302 to https://cexplgtcimdezzxuimkv.supabase.co/auth/v1/authorize?provider=google&redirect_to=.../dashboard which then cleanly lands on https://accounts.google.com/v3/signin/identifier (real Google Sign-In screen showing 'to continue to cexplgtcimdezzxuimkv.supabase.co'). No 'Unsupported provider' / 'provider is not enabled' text in the page body, no 4xx/5xx response from Supabase auth endpoints. (3) Same clean redirect verified on /signup via [data-testid=signup-google-button]. Regression: email/password login with demo.escritor@cowriter.test / CoWriter#2026 still works — reached /dashboard, header renders 'CoWriter | 5 credits | History | language selector | logout' and the 6 existing projects load correctly. UNVERIFIABLE BY AUTOMATION: the final step of Google OAuth (choosing a real Google account, consenting, and being redirected back to /dashboard with a Supabase session) cannot be tested by any automated agent — it requires an interactive real Google account. All observable evidence up to that boundary shows the fix is correct.
action_items: None. Google OAuth provider fix is verified up to the Google consent screen. Only interactive human testing with a real Google account can validate the final callback → session → /dashboard hop; recommend main agent ask the user to run that one manual click test.

OAuth client id observed in Google redirect: 167809373098-cahkr5llcf60af7eqt013djoao4ngkpm.apps.googleusercontent.com — matches user's Google Cloud OAuth client. redirect_uri is https://cexplgtcimdezzxuimkv.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback (Supabase-managed) — user must have this exact URI in the Google Cloud OAuth 'Authorized redirect URIs' list, which appears to be the case since Google accepted the request.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Google OAuth is configured end-to-end at the Supabase + Google Cloud level. The only unverifiable segment is the actual Google consent + callback hop which requires interactive human credentials. If a future agent wants to test post-callback behavior, they must be given a real (throwaway) Google account and manual assist; automation cannot solve the interactive Google consent page. Email/password login remains the reliable automation path.
rca of the issue: Original bug: 'Unsupported provider: provider is not enabled' when clicking 'Continuar com Google'. RCA: Google provider was disabled/not-configured in Supabase Dashboard (Auth → Providers → Google), so gotrue rejected the authorize call. Fix (config-only, not code): user created a Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Client (client_id 167809373098-cahkr5llcf60af7eqt013djoao4ngkpm.apps.googleusercontent.com), pasted client_id + client_secret into Supabase Dashboard, set the Google provider to Enabled, and saved. Supabase /auth/v1/settings now advertises external.google=true. Verified: 302 to accounts.google.com happens cleanly with no provider error.
